<p dir="auto">Use <code>images</code> instead of <code>image</code> for multi-image rows. Relative image paths are
resolved against <code>dataset.image_root</code> when set. See
<a href="/Liquid4All/leap-finetune/blob/main/job_configs/vlm_dpo_example.yaml"><code>job_configs/vlm_dpo_example.yaml</code></a> for a
complete LoRA config. <code>freeze_vision_encoder</code> and
<code>optimizer_type: "adamw_8bit"</code> are optional knobs, not defaults.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">GRPO and VLM GRPO</h3><a id="user-content-grpo-and-vlm-grpo" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: GRPO and VLM GRPO" href="#grpo-and-vlm-grpo"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">GRPO can reuse the SFT/VLM SFT <code>messages</code> format. The loader turns each row
into <code>prompt</code> and <code>solution</code> for online reward computation, and any extra
columns are forwarded to reward functions. See <a href="#grpo">GRPO</a> for the full
dataset, reward, and vLLM rollout contract.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Tool Calling Datasets</h2><a id="user-content-tool-calling-datasets" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Tool Calling Datasets" href="#tool-calling-datasets"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Tool calls use LFM bracket notation in the assistant <code>content</code> field. Tool
definitions go in the system prompt, and tool responses use <code>role: "tool"</code>.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-json notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre>{
  <span class="pl-ent">"messages"</span>: [
    {
      <span class="pl-ent">"role"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>system<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>,
      <span class="pl-ent">"content"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>List of tools: [{<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>type<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>:<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>function<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>,<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>function<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>:{<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>name<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>:<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>get_weather<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>,<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>description<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>:<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>Get weather for a city<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>,<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>parameters<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>:{<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>type<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>:<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>object<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>,<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>properties<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>:{<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>location<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>:{<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>type<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>:<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>string<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>}},<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>required<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>:[<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>location<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>]}}}]<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
    },
    { <span class="pl-ent">"role"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>user<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>, <span class="pl-ent">"content"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>What's the weather in Boston?<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span> },
    {
      <span class="pl-ent">"role"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>assistant<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>,
      <span class="pl-ent">"content"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span><|tool_call_start|>[get_weather(location=<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>Boston<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>)]<|tool_call_end|><span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
    },
    {
      <span class="pl-ent">"role"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>tool<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>,
      <span class="pl-ent">"content"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>{<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>temperature<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>: 72, <span class="pl-cce">\"</span>condition<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>: <span class="pl-cce">\"</span>sunny<span class="pl-cce">\"</span>}<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
    },
    { <span class="pl-ent">"role"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>assistant<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>, <span class="pl-ent">"content"</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>It's 72 F and sunny in Boston.<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span> }
  ]
}</pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

      "role": "system",

<ul dir="auto">
<li>Tool calls must be pre-baked in <code>content</code> using
<code><|tool_call_start|>[func(args)]<|tool_call_end|></code> bracket notation.</li>
<li>Structured <code>tool_calls</code> fields in OpenAI format are auto-converted when
present.</li>
<li>Foreign formats such as <code><tool_call></code> XML are rejected with an actionable
error.</li>
<li>Do not include <code><|tool_response_start|></code> or <code><|tool_response_end|></code> markers
in <code>role: "tool"</code> messages. The LFM2 chat template adds them during
tokenization.</li>
<li>LFM2 models expect <code><|tool_list_start|></code> and <code><|tool_list_end|></code> around tool
definitions in the system prompt. Include them for LFM2 and omit them for
LFM2.5. The pipeline warns on mismatches and auto-strips
<code><|tool_list_start|></code> when training LFM2.5.</li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto">To resume a run, <code>save_only_model</code> must be <code>False</code>. The wandb run ID is saved
to <code><run_dir>/.wandb_run_id</code>; resumed runs reuse the same wandb run, and fresh
runs create a new one.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">GRPO</h2><a id="user-content-grpo" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: GRPO" href="#grpo"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">GRPO runs online RL with TRL v1's <code>GRPOTrainer</code>. Use <code>training_type: "grpo"</code>
for text models and <code>training_type: "vlm_grpo"</code> for vision-language models.
Both modes use the same YAML entrypoint as SFT/DPO, the same Ray Train
launcher, and vLLM rollouts by default.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Dataset Contract</h3><a id="user-content-dataset-contract" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Dataset Contract" href="#dataset-contract"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Text GRPO can reuse the SFT <code>messages</code> format: the loader builds <code>prompt</code> from
non-assistant turns and <code>solution</code> from the last assistant message. Native
<code>prompt</code> / <code>solution</code> columns also work. VLM GRPO uses the same multimodal
<code>messages</code> shape as VLM SFT. Extra dataset columns are forwarded to reward
functions as keyword arguments.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Rewards</h3><a id="user-content-rewards" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Rewards" href="#rewards"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

referenced by function name:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-yaml notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-ent">rewards</span>:

<code>weights:</code> override must match the expanded reward list. Absolute paths and
<code>./rewards/file.py::function_name</code> specs work for custom rewards.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Judge LLM Reward</h3><a id="user-content-judge-llm-reward" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Judge LLM Reward" href="#judge-llm-reward"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Add <code>rewards.judge</code> when the reward signal should come from an LLM grader.
Without <code>base_url</code>, the driver starts a local <code>trl vllm-serve</code> judge server
before Ray initializes and exports the endpoint to workers:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-yaml notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-ent">rewards</span>:
  <span class="pl-ent">judge</span>:
    <span class="pl-ent">model</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>LFM2-1.2B<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
    <span class="pl-ent">weight</span>: <span class="pl-c1">1.0</span>
    <span class="pl-ent">prompt_template</span>: <span class="pl-s">|</span>
<span class="pl-s">      Prompt:</span>
<span class="pl-s">      {prompt}</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">      Assistant response:</span>
<span class="pl-s">      {completion}</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">      Reference answer or rubric:</span>
<span class="pl-s">      {solution}</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s">      Return only JSON: {"score": 0.0}</span>
<span class="pl-s"></span>
<span class="pl-s"></span><span class="pl-ent">grpo_rollout</span>:
  <span class="pl-ent">judge_gpus</span>: <span class="pl-c1">1</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">

  judge_gpus: 1" tabindex="0" role="button">

<p dir="auto">For an external judge, set <code>rewards.judge.base_url</code> and omit <code>judge_gpus</code>.
Judge scores are parsed from JSON or the first number in the response and
normalized from <code>min_score</code>/<code>max_score</code> to <code>[0, 1]</code>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">vLLM Rollouts</h3><a id="user-content-vllm-rollouts" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: vLLM Rollouts" href="#vllm-rollouts"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><code>DEFAULT_GRPO</code> and <code>DEFAULT_VLM_GRPO</code> set <code>use_vllm: true</code> and
<code>vllm_mode: "colocate"</code>. Colocate mode runs vLLM inside each training worker.
Server mode starts <code>trl vllm-serve</code> on driver GPUs before Ray initializes.
Configure GPU counts, not device ids:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-yaml notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-ent">grpo_rollout</span>:
  <span class="pl-ent">server_gpus</span>: <span class="pl-c1">1</span> <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> reserve 1 local GPU for vLLM; training gets the rest</span>
  <span class="pl-ent">judge_gpus</span>: <span class="pl-c1">1</span> <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> optional: reserve 1 local GPU for rewards.judge</span>
  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> training_gpus: 3    # or set only this and vLLM gets the remaining GPUs</span>
  <span class="pl-ent">tensor_parallel_size</span>: <span class="pl-c1">1</span>
  <span class="pl-ent">dtype</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>bfloat16<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
  <span class="pl-ent">gpu_memory_utilization</span>: <span class="pl-c1">0.9</span>

<span class="pl-ent">training_config</span>:
  <span class="pl-ent">extends</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>DEFAULT_GRPO<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
  <span class="pl-ent">vllm_mode</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>server<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
  <span class="pl-ent">vllm_server_host</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>auto<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>
  <span class="pl-ent">vllm_server_port</span>: <span class="pl-c1">8000</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="grpo_rollout:
  server_gpus: 1 # reserve 1 local GPU for vLLM; training gets the rest
  judge_gpus: 1 # optional: reserve 1 local GPU for rewards.judge
  # training_gpus: 3    # or set only this and vLLM gets the remaining GPUs
  tensor_parallel_size: 1
  dtype: "bfloat16"
  gpu_memory_utilization: 0.9

training_config:
  extends: "DEFAULT_GRPO"
  vllm_mode: "server"
  vllm_server_host: "auto"
  vllm_server_port: 8000" tabindex="0" role="button">

<p dir="auto">Local server partitioning is single-node only. For multi-node GRPO, use
colocate mode or point <code>vllm_server_base_url</code> at an externally managed vLLM
server without setting <code>server_gpus</code> or <code>training_gpus</code>.</p>
<p dir="auto">Example configs:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><a href="/Liquid4All/leap-finetune/blob/main/job_configs/grpo_example.yaml"><code>job_configs/grpo_example.yaml</code></a>: text GRPO
quickstart with the GSM8K recipe.</li>
<li><a href="/Liquid4All/leap-finetune/blob/main/job_configs/grpo_server_mode_example.yaml"><code>job_configs/grpo_server_mode_example.yaml</code></a>:
text GRPO with a local <code>trl vllm-serve</code> rollout server.</li>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Async Eval (vLLM)</h3><a id="user-content-async-eval-vllm" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Async Eval (vLLM)" href="#async-eval-vllm"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">By default, every <code>eval_steps</code> blocks training until benchmarks finish. For
large generation suites this dominates wall-clock time. Add an <code>async_eval</code>
block to run benchmarks <strong>without blocking training</strong>, using vLLM for the
actual generation. Results are logged to wandb with <code>benchmark/step</code> and
<code>train/global_step</code> fields so dashboards can align benchmark metrics to the
training step that triggered them.</p>
<p dir="auto">Three modes (default is <code>sync</code> = today's behavior):</p>
<markdown-accessiblity-table data-catalyst=""><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Mode</th>
<th>Engine</th>
<th>Pauses training?</th>
<th>GPUs reserved</th>
<th>Latency</th>
<th>Multi-node training</th>
<th>Best for</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>sync</code></td>
<td>HF transformers</td>
<td>Yes</td>
<td>None</td>
<td>Immediate</td>
<td>✓</td>
<td>Small/fast eval suites; default</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>sidecar</code></td>
<td>vLLM</td>
<td><strong>No</strong></td>
<td>None (slurm-scheduled per cycle)</td>
<td>Slurm queue + eval time</td>
<td>✓</td>
<td>Tight clusters; eval should be free of training cost</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>reserved</code></td>
<td>vLLM</td>
<td><strong>No</strong></td>
<td>N throughout the run</td>
<td>~30–60s respawn per cycle</td>
<td><strong>Single-node only</strong></td>
<td>Spare GPUs on one node, want predictable eval latency</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></markdown-accessiblity-table>
<p dir="auto"><code>reserved</code> mode carves its GPUs off the same SLURM allocation as
training via the driver's <code>CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES</code>, which only affects
the head node. Multi-node training will raise <code>NotImplementedError</code>
at startup — use <code>sidecar</code> instead, which scales to any node count.</p>
<p dir="auto">Async sidecar mode serves generation through vLLM and falls back to an HF model
inside the sidecar for benchmark types vLLM cannot serve, such as logprob
scoring. Reserved mode keeps a persistent vLLM server and should be used for
generation benchmarks; use <code>sync</code> or <code>sidecar</code> for logprob suites.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-yaml notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Opt in by adding this block. See job_configs/sft_with_async_eval_example.yaml</span>
<span class="pl-ent">async_eval</span>:
  <span class="pl-ent">mode</span>: <span class="pl-s">sidecar </span><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> sync (default) | sidecar | reserved</span>
  <span class="pl-ent">vllm_gpus</span>: <span class="pl-c1">1</span>
  <span class="pl-ent">tensor_parallel_size</span>: <span class="pl-c1">1</span>

<p dir="auto">Failures are isolated: if eval crashes or sbatch is rejected, training continues. environment that includes the private Liquid4All <code>lmms-eval</code> fork with LFM2
model support.</p>

<p dir="auto">Default base configs live in
<a href="/Liquid4All/leap-finetune/blob/main/src/leap_finetune/training/default_configs"><code>src/leap_finetune/training/default_configs/</code></a>
and are auto-discovered. New configs added to those files are immediately
available via <code>extends</code> in YAML.</p>
<p dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/linkedin/Liger-Kernel">Liger Kernel</a> is installed by the
default CUDA group. Enable it with <code>use_liger_kernel: true</code> in
<code>training_config</code>.</p>
<p dir="auto">LoRA is configured through <code>peft_config</code>. Continued LoRA training can load an
existing adapter with <code>adapter_path</code>; VLM configs can optionally freeze the
vision encoder with <code>freeze_vision_encoder</code> and use bitsandbytes 8-bit AdamW
with <code>optimizer_type: "adamw_8bit"</code>.</p>
<p dir="auto">Pinned chat templates live in
<a href="/Liquid4All/leap-finetune/blob/main/job_configs/chat_templates"><code>job_configs/chat_templates/</code></a>. Non-local
LiquidAI LFM2.5 and LFM2-24B models select the pinned LFM2.5 template by
default.</p>
